source.fantasy: ESPN full-PPR receiving box scores aligned to charted route weeks
source.coverage: Receiving values require all verified route weeks to match nflverse

definitions.routeShare: Total routes / sum of team passing-play opportunities in charted route weeks × 100
definitions.yacPerReception: nflverse receiving yards after catch / receptions in verified route weeks
definitions.firstDownsPerRoute: nflverse receiving first downs / charted routes in verified route weeks
definitions.epaPerTarget: nflverse receiving EPA / nflverse targets in verified route weeks
definitions.fantasyPointsPerRoute: ESPN recorded (receptions + receiving yards / 10 + receiving touchdowns × 6) / same-week charted routes
